name: Hioki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hioki city emblem in navy and red: a navy stylised swoosh of curved strokes with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Hioki, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 May 2005.

features.role: Hioki city emblem — a navy stylised swoosh of curved strokes with a red disc
